legacy_findings.finding: Repository visibility conflicts with the private-code statement
legacy_findings.evidence: GitHub still reports public visibility. RSH-012 establishes an explicit proprietary licence but does not change repository visibility.
legacy_findings.remediation: Owner changes visibility to private; live re-verification

legacy_findings.finding: `main` is not protected
legacy_findings.evidence: GitHub reports `protected=false`, required checks 0 and rulesets 0. RSH-008 records the desired ruleset, but no administrative mutation has been applied.

legacy_findings.finding: No branch-and-PR delivery workflow exists
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-001–RSH-013 use isolated branches and PRs; governance, CODEOWNERS and templates are versioned. Live settings enforcement remains absent.

legacy_findings.finding: No GitHub Actions CI is present
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-007 merged `required-ci / validate`; exact-head CI remains the acceptance authority.

legacy_findings.finding: The QA command is not self-contained
legacy_findings.evidence: The RSH-006 harness starts, validates and stops its own server in CI.

legacy_findings.finding: Automation contains absolute `/workspace` paths
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-005 migrated executable automation to module-relative roots; `check:paths` prevents recurrence.

legacy_findings.finding: Secret scanning is too narrow
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-024 scans tracked text under `src/`, `scripts/`, `server/` and `.github/` with eight fail-closed patterns instead of only `src/game`.

legacy_findings.finding: Operational contracts are ignored by Git
legacy_findings.evidence: Governance, contribution, security, toolchain, QA, CI, product and metadata contracts are versioned; ignored AGENTS/startup files still require a decision.

legacy_findings.finding: Program status sources contradict one another
legacy_findings.evidence: Canonical state, queue, master plan and NEXT authority are merged; historical files are explicitly non-controlling.

legacy_findings.finding: The last audit is stale and sequencing rules were violated
legacy_findings.evidence: The queue was reset, product scope was frozen, all 56 tracks were classified and asset/metadata authorities were established; vertical-slice enforcement remains pending.

legacy_findings.finding: No version, tag, release or rollback baseline exists
legacy_findings.evidence: Immutable baseline, milestone, label and release registers exist; tags, releases and rollback proof remain absent.

legacy_findings.finding: Root licensing and asset provenance are incomplete
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-011 inventories 134/134 public files; RSH-012 establishes the proprietary root licence. Exactly 66 asset files remain unverified and uncleared.
legacy_findings.remediation: Replace or document every unverified asset; keep public distribution blocked

legacy_findings.finding: Production QA-hook removal is not enforced by GitHub
legacy_findings.evidence: `check:qa` passes inside the required workflow, but GitHub does not yet require that check through branch settings.
legacy_findings.remediation: Apply the RSH-008 desired ruleset; RSH-024 hardening

legacy_findings.finding: Timed-record hashes are generated but not verified on read
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-023 verifies SHA-256 record hashes on every load, drops stale physics versions and structurally invalid rows, and bounds storage to 24 per track/car plus 200 overall.

legacy_findings.finding: Timed-record writes are fire-and-forget
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-023 serialises persist through one in-module chain, replaces `rush.records.v3` with canonical JSON, verifies the write, and returns structured duplicate/rejected/write-failed status without deleting source bytes.

legacy_findings.finding: Save failures and corruption are silently swallowed
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-021 establishes deterministic schema/version handling. RSH-022 adds verified backup rotation, bounded exact-byte quarantine, explicit restore/fresh-start decisions, structured failures and accessible bilingual failure UI without deleting source or legacy bytes.

legacy_findings.finding: The build command performs database migration
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-020 removes the DB subsystem and migration scripts; `npm run build` is exactly `vite build`.
